fullPassage: As individuals, our ability to thrive depended on how well we navigated relationships in a group. If the group valued us, we could count on support, resources, and probably a mate. If it didn't, we might get none of these merits. It was a matter of survival, physically and genetically. Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the development of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us. We process that information in the form of self-esteem and such related emotions as pride, shame, or insecurity. These emotions compel us to do more of what makes our community value us and less of what doesn't. And, crucially, they are meant to make that motivation feel like it is coming from within. If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might come off as grudging or cynical, making it less persuasive.

④ merit ←정답: '칭찬받을 만한 좋은 특성, 이점'이라는 정의에 맞는 '이점, 장점'
det.tip: 'good quality', 'advantage'에 주목하세요.

questions.passage: Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the __________ (develop) of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 그 결과는 남들이 우리를 어떻게 인식하는지 무의식적으로 감시하는 경향의 '발달'이었다.
det.analysis:
'The result was the __________ (develop) of ~'에서 앞에 관사 the가 있고 뒤에 전치사 of가 이어져요. 이 자리에는 동사가 아니라 명사가 필요해요.

동사 develop의 명사형은 development(발달)이므로 정답은 development예요.
det.tip: the ___ of 자리에는 명사가 와요. develop → development(명사)로 바꾸세요.

questions.passage: If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might come off as grudging or cynical, making it less __________ (persuade).
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: 우리의 수행이 마지못하거나 냉소적으로 보여서 덜 '설득력 있게' 만든다.
det.analysis:
'making it less __________ (persuade)'에서 less 뒤에는 형용사가 와서 '덜 ~한'이라는 뜻을 만들어요.

동사 persuade(설득하다)의 형용사형은 persuasive(설득력 있는)이므로 정답은 persuasive예요.
det.tip: less 다음에는 형용사가 와요. persuade → persuasive(형용사)로 바꾸세요.

questions.passage: As individuals, our ability to thrive depended on how well we navigated relationships in a group. If the group valued us, we could __________ support, resources, and probably a mate. If it didn't, we might get none of these merits. It was a matter of survival, physically and genetically. Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the development of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us. We process that information in the form of self-esteem and such related emotions as pride, shame, or insecurity. These emotions compel us to do more of what makes our community value us and less of what doesn't. And, crucially, they are meant to make that motivation feel like it is coming from within. If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might come off as grudging or cynical, making it less persuasive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① count on ←정답: 집단이 우리를 인정하면 지지, 자원, 짝을 '기대할(의지할)' 수 있다는 흐름이에요
② give up: 포기한다는 건 반대
③ take over: 인계받다는 무관
④ carry out: 수행하다는 무관
det.tip: 집단이 인정하면 도움을 '기대할 수 있다'는 흐름이에요. count on = 의지하다.

questions.passage: As individuals, our ability to thrive depended on how well we navigated relationships in a group. If the group valued us, we could count on support, resources, and probably a mate. If it didn't, we might get none of these merits. It was a matter of survival, physically and genetically. Over millions of years, the pressure selected for people who are sensitive to and skilled at maximizing their standing. The result was the development of a tendency to unconsciously monitor how other people in our community perceive us. We process that information in the form of self-esteem and such related emotions as pride, shame, or insecurity. These emotions compel us to do more of what makes our community value us and less of what doesn't. And, crucially, they are meant to make that motivation feel like it is coming from within. If we realized, on a conscious level, that we were responding to social pressure, our performance might __________ grudging or cynical, making it less persuasive.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.analysis:
① give rise to: 일으키다는 문맥과 안 맞음
② come off as ←정답: 사회적 압박에 반응하는 걸 의식하면 수행이 마지못하거나 냉소적으로 '보인다'는 흐름이에요
③ make up for: 보상하다는 무관
④ hold on to: 붙잡다는 무관
det.tip: come off as ~ 는 '~라는 인상을 주다, ~처럼 보이다'라는 뜻이에요.
